admission_requirements.general_requirements: Jordanian General Secondary Certificate (Tawjihi) or equivalent. All high school certificates in Arab countries are accepted if authenticated by Jordanian Ministry of Education. Non-Jordanian students with vocational diplomas must submit applications to the Jordanian Ministry of Education for certificate equalization.
admission_requirements.exam_details: No general entrance exam; placement tests may be required for language proficiency.
admission_requirements.english_requirement: TOEFL or IELTS required for postgraduate program admission; not specified for undergraduate admission. Students who fail to prove English proficiency may study a qualifying program of 6 additional credit hours.
admission_requirements.bridging_system: Community college diploma with 68% or above. Maximum 66 credit hours transferred for 2-year system. Non-Jordanian community college graduates: maximum 30 credit hours with minimum 68% grade. Special needs bridging minimum: 65% with medical documentation.

faculties: Faculty of Business Administration and Finance
Faculty of Science and Information Technology

tuition_fees.fee_structure: Per credit hour, after discount for Jordanian students
tuition_fees.notes: Tuition charged per credit hour. Fees shown are after discount for Jordanian students. International students may have different rates.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: No confirmed on-campus dormitories. International Relations Office reportedly facilitates accommodation for international students through external housing.
campus_facilities.sports_details: Gym established 2007 with facilities for football, basketball, volleyball, tennis, bodybuilding, squash, billiards, table tennis, and bowling. Outdoor stadium founded 2000 with football field and capacity for 5,000 spectators.
campus_facilities.health_center_details: Health Care Center located inside campus providing health services for students.
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Scholarships available for top-performing students; financial aid programs may be available.
